$comment: Keen verification gates. pnpm verify runs the fast tier, pnpm verify:build the build tier, pnpm verify:live the live tier. Every gate in tools/token-generator/src/gates.ts must be listed here.

gates.description: token files are valid DTCG with tiers, types, units, descriptions, and resolvable references
generated CSS and typed map are deterministic and match the token sources
the committed resolved-token baseline matches the token sources
every Component Contract contrast pair passes in light and dark
design/keen.variables.json holds exactly the Pen variables the tokens generate
design/keen.pen's variables, read through the pen CLI, match the tokens
no component forwards className or style onto its internals
component code reads only generated semantic and component tokens: no primitives, no phantoms
every token a component reads is listed in its Component Contract
the packed package exports only ./react, ./styles.css, and ./tokens, and internals are not importable
apps/fixture-astro installs the packed package, themes it through semantic tokens, and builds
